sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import json
def barpos(frame):
    rows = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    def runs(line, ch):
        out=[]
        for c,x in enumerate(line):
            if x==ch:
                if out and c==out[-1][1]+1: out[-1][1]=c
                else: out.append([c,c])
        return out
    for r in range(64):
        rr = runs(rows[r],'b')
        if rr: return (r, rr[0][0], rr[0][1])
    return None
def done_check():
    return last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('score',0)>0

stages = [
    (['LEFT']*3,  "left edge"),
    (['RIGHT']*7, "center under flag (cols 28-47)"),
    (['UP']*1,    "top row"),
    (['DOWN']*7,  "bottom row"),
    (['RIGHT']*2, "left-edge aligned w/ flag (cols 36-55)"),
    (['UP']*7,    "top row again"),
    (['RIGHT']*2, "right side (cols 40-59+)"),
]
for acts, label in stages:
    for a in acts:
        action([a])
        if done_check():
            print("COMPLETED after", label, barpos(current_frame))
            raise SystemExit
    print(label, "->", barpos(current_frame), "score", last_action_result.get('score'))
print("no completion in sweep; final:", barpos(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

import json
def barpos(frame):
    rows = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    def runs(line, ch):
        out=[]
        for c,x in enumerate(line):
            if x==ch:
                if out and c==out[-1][1]+1: out[-1][1]=c
                else: out.append([c,c])
        return out
    for r in range(64):
        rr = runs(rows[r],'b')
        if rr: return (r, rr[0][0], rr[0][1])
    return None
def done_check():
    return last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('score',0)>0

stages = [
    (['LEFT']*3,  "left edge"),
    (['RIGHT']*7, "center under flag (cols 28-47)"),
    (['UP']*1,    "top row"),
    (['DOWN']*7,  "bottom row"),
    (['RIGHT']*2, "left-edge aligned w/ flag (cols 36-55)"),
    (['UP']*7,    "top row again"),
    (['RIGHT']*2, "right side (cols 40-59+)"),
]
for acts, label in stages:
    for a in acts:
        action([a])
        if done_check():
            print("COMPLETED after", label, barpos(current_frame))
            raise SystemExit
    print(label, "->", barpos(current_frame), "score", last_action_result.get('score'))
print("no completion in sweep; final:", barpos(current_frame))
